about: The intent of this repository, as data. Every statement below is quoted from a document the Maintainer wrote, and tests/test_layers.py fails if a quote stops matching its source. Nothing here was composed for this file.
how_to_ratify: Edit the statements until they are yours, then set ratified to true, ratified_by to your name and ratified_on to the date. Only the Maintainer does this. An agent may propose a statement in a message and must not set these three fields.
name: recursive-symbolics

purpose.text: It takes a symbolic state from any caller and returns typed records

principles.text: A lens can never write back into an address
Every reading carries its caveat, names the tradition and the source it read from, and points at the words it came from.
No output may rank a person, and none may command: it offers.
Nothing is forced to a verdict.
This engine reads the person asking, and no one else.
The Conformance Suite is the answer about compliance, not your judgement of it.
Corrections are new entries, never edits that erase what was believed before.
